Hero City is spooky level 1 (DESIGN-027), so the lens eye may glow red in dim light. Attack: the warning light spins, then a pincer lunge. Defeat: sparks, the dome pops and it slumps smoking, held.

original_work: Final topology, UVs, weights, the 46-joint rig and all five clips are new; the approved blockout supplied measured proportions, colours, parody hooks and the sheet-pose coordinates (the slinky arm centrelines, both claw frames, the eyelid tilt, the glance and the cord path) only.
